name: Log Lake Campground
evidence: county site map (LOG LAKE UPDATED SITE MAP.pdf) + Campspot per-site map: site 40 (Campspot 'Waterfront Electric Only Site', county $45 rate) at the NE end of the park's own swim beach; Wayback z19 leaf-off (2020/2022) with OSM bathhouse/shelter: ~30-35 m to Log Lake across open sand, no road or treeline. Other loops set back behind trees

name: Marion Lake Campground
evidence: Wayback z19 (2022 leaf-on, 2024 leaf-off) with OSM pitches: lakeside spurs off the shore road sit ~20-45 m above Marion Lake behind a continuous conifer shore belt (one RV ~27 m back through trees); FS page: lakeside spurs give views of the lake. No per-site map, so not on-water

name: Metamora-Hadley Recreation Area Campground
evidence: DNR campground map (metamora-hadley_camp_map.pdf): north-loop sites ~151-169 on the lake side of the loop road; Esri satellite 42.9434,-83.3506: RVs on those pads ~15-20 m from Lake Minnawanna across open unused lawn, no road or treeline; DEM 288 m at pads = lake (dam is elsewhere)

name: Minnie Pond Campground
evidence: Esri + Wayback z19 (2014, 2022) at 43.6281,-85.8996: road ends at a posted turnaround/parking lot ~50-60 m from Minnie Pond across an open lawn (upstream of the spillway); no RV pads identifiable at the water and no per-site map, so default down

name: Monocle Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov 234617 site points (no Proximity-to-Water tags) on Wayback 2014 z19: west-row sites 34-38 ~70-80 m from Monocle Lake's beach behind continuous forest; 39-42 beside the day-use launch lot, also behind trees; FS 'surrounds the south end' is prose

name: Natalie State Forest Campground
evidence: Wayback 2014 z19 leaf-off + Esri at 46.3510,-85.5790: loop on a point in the Dollarville Flooding; N/NW spur pads ~10-20 m from open water across leafless brush, west loop road ~10-15 m from the water. No per-site map and no vehicle in frame; verifier proposed lakefront at low confidence, coordinator held it at lakeview (default down). DNR 'located on the flooding'

name: Ocqueoc Falls State Forest Campground
evidence: Wayback z19 (2014 sharp, 2020 leaf-off) with OSM loop at 45.3942,-84.0572: west loop road and pads ~25-32 m from the Ocqueoc River behind a continuous conifer belt, no sightline; other pads further east; DNR 'on the Ocqueoc River' is prose

name: Newaygo State Park Campground
evidence: old pin was a forest road ~480 m SSE; re-pinned to Oak loop (OSM). DNR camp map + Wayback 2022 leaf-off z19: Oak lobes ~50 m and Poplar top pads ~40 m from Hardy Dam Pond, atop the 20-ft embankment behind forest
